no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: All 17 ctgov registry trials are TERMINATED (8), COMPLETED (5), WITHDRAWN (2), UNKNOWN (1), or ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING with primary completion date 2021-12-30 (1, effectively dormant CYNK-001 COVID-19 study). Per the FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-04-30), the company has refocused on health longevity using placental-derived therapies; cenplacel-L (PDA-001/PDA-002) Phase 2 program is complete and pending an FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting, with no new actively enrolling trial reported. Pipeline page lists PDA-002 for FSHD as Phase 1 'Ready' (not initiated). CAR-T (pT) and pT/pNK programs are at discovery stage. The company also licensed/divested major cell-therapy and biomaterial programs (Celeniv license; April 2026 NexGel divestiture of biomaterials business).

website.note: Lists MLASC PDA-001/002 (Phase 2 complete, awaiting FDA EOP-2), PDA-002 FSHD (Phase 1 Ready/not started), pT and pT/pNK (Discovery). No active enrolling trials with NCT IDs.

ctgov.note: All terminated/withdrawn/completed/unknown. NCT04365101 (CYNK-001 COVID-19) is ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING but primary completion 2021-12-30 — long-term follow-up only, not active enrollment.

excluded_preclinical.stage: Phase 1 'Ready' on company pipeline page; trial not yet initiated, no IND/NCT disclosed.

excluded_legacy_terminated.asset: CYNK-001 (NK cell) — recurrent GBM IV/IC + IL2 (NCT05218408)

commercial_product.note: Biomaterials business divested to NexGel, Inc. announced April 2026; Celeniv license also covers certain biomaterials and pipeline programs.
